en-US.name: Across Us: Friends & Trips
en-US.subtitle: Share cities & travel plans
en-US.promotionalText: Friends in other cities? Add where you’re headed, see whose plans overlap with yours, and plan the trip together — flights and all.
en-US.description:
Your friends are spread across cities. Across Us helps you catch them when your paths cross: see where everyone is, find the dates you’ll be in the same city, and plan group trips with everyone’s flights in one place.

Made for friends who live apart — after graduation, a move abroad, or a new job across the country.

WHERE EVERYONE IS
• See the city each friend has shared, and when they last updated it.
• See when a friend is in the same city as you.
• Keep friends on your Home Screen and Lock Screen with widgets.

WHEN YOU’LL MEET
• Add the cities and dates you’re traveling, and choose which friends can see them.
• Browse the travel plans friends share with you.
• When your shared plans put you in the same city, Together soon shows the dates — then share a meetup invite.

TRAVEL TOGETHER
• Create a shared trip and invite friends.
• Everyone adds their own flights. See all the routes on one map.
• Check who has landed, who’s on the way, and who still needs to add a flight.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Friends see a city, never your exact location. Precise coordinates are not sent to our servers.
• No contacts upload, no ads, no cross-app tracking.
• Pause sharing for everyone or for one friend, and choose who sees each plan. Prefer not to share location? Pick your city manually.
• Sign in with Apple.

City updates, widgets and notifications depend on iOS permissions and connectivity. Confirm flight details with your airline.

zh-Hans.subtitle: 分享城市，发现下一次相聚
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 朋友在别的城市？添加你的下一站，看看谁的行程和你重叠；一起出发时，大家的航班都在同一个行程里。
zh-Hans.keywords: 朋友,好友,同城,旅行,行程,航班,小组件,出行,聚会,见面,留学,异地,结伴
zh-Hans.description:
朋友散落在不同城市？Across Us 帮你抓住每一次相遇：看看大家在哪，发现你们会在同一座城市的日子；一起出发时，所有人的航班都在同一个行程里。

适合毕业后各奔东西、出国留学或异地工作的朋友。

大家现在在哪
• 查看每位好友分享的城市和更新时间。
• 朋友和你在同一座城市时，一眼就能看到。
• 用小组件把朋友放在主屏幕和锁定屏幕上。

下一次在哪见
• 添加你要去的城市和日期，选择分享给哪些好友。
• 浏览朋友分享给你的出行计划。
• 双方分享的计划落在同一座城市时，“即将相聚”会显示重叠日期，还能直接分享见面邀约。

一起旅行
• 创建共同旅行，邀请朋友加入。
• 每个人添加自己的航班，在一张地图上看到所有人的航线。
• 谁已落地、谁还在路上、谁还没添加航班，一目了然。

隐私，从设计开始
• 朋友只看到城市，看不到你的精确位置；精确坐标不会发送到我们的服务器。
• 不上传通讯录，没有广告，不做跨 App 追踪。
• 可以暂停对所有人或某位好友的城市共享，并为每份计划选择可见好友；不想授权定位，也能手动选择城市。
• 通过 Apple 登录。

城市更新、小组件与通知受 iOS 权限和网络影响；航班信息请以航空公司为准。
